declaration.notes: All Vocal v1 audit-derived Swift contracts and research protocols are independently authored TrackSmith material. Inspiration is not shipping approval.

references.name: basic-pitch
references.abstractLessonApplied: A local offline or companion off-render audio-to-MIDI proposal must be typed, bounded, provenance-bound, source-preserving, stale-safe, and replayable.
unresolvedForReuse: complete runtime and transitive license closure
references.shippingDecision: No code, model, runtime, data, content, or output shipping approval.

references.name: RNNoise
references.abstractLessonApplied: A speech-only cleanup experiment needs explicit framing, state, off-render execution, source preservation, deterministic fixtures, and measured license/realtime gates.
references.shippingDecision: Research protocol only; no code or model import and no production-readiness claim.

references.name: webMUSHRA
references.abstractLessonApplied: Listening comparisons need blinded identities, explicit conditions, bounded scores, preference, and durable result exports.
unresolvedForReuse: complete Node and vendored dependency closure
references.shippingDecision: Reject or obtain written rights first; TrackSmith runner is independently authored.

references.name: akouste
references.abstractLessonApplied: A local study export benefits from deterministic order, artifact hashes, separate identities, integrity checks, and no-network operation.
unresolvedForReuse: optional CDN and minified dependency provenance
references.shippingDecision: Reject or obtain separate commercial rights first; TrackSmith runner is independently authored.

references.name: pluginval
references.abstractLessonApplied: New AU processors need independently authored hostile-host lifecycle coverage beyond a happy-path render.
references.shippingDecision: No linking, embedding, distribution, or source reuse; TrackSmith's host scenarios are independently authored.

references.name: chowdsp_utils
references.abstractLessonApplied: A render-thread utility must be a small independently authored fixed-capacity primitive with explicit allocation, reset, sanitizer, and parity proof.
unresolvedForReuse: notice requirements for any selected source
references.shippingDecision: No upstream material is used; the Vocal delay storage/reset implementation is clean-room TrackSmith code.

references.name: JUCE
references.abstractLessonApplied: Host edge cases are useful test scenarios, but a framework migration would weaken the established native TrackSmith boundary.
references.shippingDecision: No framework migration or reuse; native SwiftPM/macOS/AUv3 remains authoritative.

references.name: iPlug2
references.abstractLessonApplied: Cross-host reset, state, format, and lifecycle behavior should be verified independently around each new DSP path.
references.shippingDecision: No framework or source reuse; only an abstract host-testing lesson informed TrackSmith-owned tests.
